## Evidence boundaries

100 randomized cases in the *declared fixture family*, not 100 independent mechanisms.
Unseen action effects and local revision are evaluated only within the bounded symbolic
hypothesis class; a new world with a different hidden law is not guaranteed to transfer.
The default subprocess protocol is trusted-code separation, not a hostile-code sandbox.
